facts.fact: The document is the text of Zambia's Access to Information Act, 2023 (Act No. 24 of 2023), assented to on 22 December 2023, giving citizens and residence permit holders a right to information held by public and private bodies, with commencement on a date the Minister appoints by statutory instrument.
